ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISCHANGED(Status__c),
CASE( RecordType.DeveloperName,
"Product", CASE( TEXT(Status__c), "Presentation",1, "Demo",2, "Evaluation",3, "Negotiation",4, "Closed Lost",5, "Closed Won",5, 0 ),
"Equipment", CASE( TEXT(Status__c), "Demo",1, "Negotiation",2, "Closed Lost",3, "Closed Won",3, 0 ),
0 )
<
CASE( RecordType.DeveloperName,
"Product", CASE( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), "Presentation",1, "Demo",2, "Evaluation",3, "Negotiation",4, "Closed Lost",5, "Closed Won",5, 0 ),
"Equipment", CASE( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), "Demo",1, "Negotiation",2, "Closed Lost",3, "Closed Won",3, 0 ),
0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status cannot be changed to a previous stage.
